summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 7, 2026, furnishing a press release under Item 8.01 and Exhibit 99.1 under Item 9.01. The release announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Robotic Assistance Devices, Inc., received an additional RIO 180 order from an existing property management customer, expanding security coverage at a vacant property. The filing discloses no price per share, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation; no deal terms, regulatory clock, or risk-arb angle apply.
